inputs.description: Modpack version — dotted number, NO 'V' prefix (e.g. 1.1.8)
Baseline ref = commit of the LAST PUBLISHED pack version (NOT the last commit). e.g. V1.1.8 = 0b5da501. Derives <baseline>..HEAD.
Target mod name substring (from the pack) to de-risk on a fast minimal instance

tasks.label: Devtools: build minimal de-risk instance (+boot/heal)
tasks.detail: Assemble a ~90s-boot minimal instance (coremod baseline + OaT + target mod + extras) to de-risk ONE mixin before the ~8min full pack. Auto-heals missing FML deps (boot-and-heal: detect 'requires mods [X]' -> resolve modid->jar -> reboot). RPC on 127.0.0.1:25580.

tasks.label: Pack: generate client+server zips
tasks.detail: Build dist/BiggessPackCatEdition<v>.zip (client) + ...ServerPack<v>.zip. Bumps manifest+modpack.json. Self-verifies.

tasks.label: Pack: bundle check (fetchability) — PREFLIGHT
tasks.detail: Every bundle mod downloadable? (CF Approved+downloadUrl, URL 200 via GET). Run before EVERY pack release. BUG-010.

tasks.label: Pack: bundle check (orphans / completeness)
tasks.command: python3 bundle_check.py --orphans "${env:HOME}/Documents/curseforge/minecraft/Instances/Biggess Pack Cat Edition V1 TEST/mods"
tasks.detail: Jars in the instance that NO bundle delivers (would be missing for players).

tasks.label: Pack: sync bundle fileIDs vs GitHub (audit)
tasks.detail: Compare pack bundles vs real GitHub releases — catches stale forks outside the tracking. Preflight before a pack release.

tasks.label: Pack: sync bundle fileIDs (apply)
tasks.detail: Write synced fileIDs into curse.bundle + client_manifest + server_jar + url.bundle (byte-mode, preserves CRLF).

tasks.label: Pack: publish changelog (derive→preview)
tasks.detail: Derive (bundles+config since baseline) → preview the publish-ready block. For curated wording: derive to a file, edit it, then changelog_publish.py --from-derive <file>.

tasks.label: Pack: publish changelog (derive→PREPEND)
tasks.detail: Insert the derived block into the pack CHANGELOG for real (uncurated — prefer --from-derive with a curated file for player-facing wording).

tasks.label: Pack: smoke test (server)
tasks.detail: Boot a throwaway server clone, report PASS/FAIL. Never touches the real instance.

tasks.label: Pack: smoke test (server + client auto-join)
tasks.detail: Server stays up, client boots + joins; confirmed via server log. Needs DISPLAY.

tasks.label: Release: dry-run all mods
tasks.detail: Stage 1 verify (tree/branch/targets) + Stage 2 build/plan. Publishes nothing.

tasks.label: Release: EXECUTE all mods (publishes!)
tasks.detail: REAL: tag + build + GitHub + CurseForge + Modrinth. Outward/public.

tasks.label: Local: update instances (dry-run)
tasks.detail: Preview swapping built personal jars into main/TEST/server.

tasks.label: Local: update instances (apply)
tasks.detail: rm old + cp new jars into instances. Launch with -Dmoddirector.devMode=true after.

tasks.label: Housekeep: archive resolved bugs (dry-run)
tasks.detail: Preview moving resolved bugs from BUGS.md to BUGS-archive.md.

tasks.label: Verify tokens (CF + Modrinth)
tasks.detail: Check the upload tokens are valid before a release.

tasks.label: Config: diff canonical vs instances
tasks.detail: Preview game-config drift: canonical src/common/config vs TEST+server. A config CHANGE is edited in the CANONICAL (never the instance directly). Add --only <path> manually to scope.

tasks.label: Config: APPLY canonical -> instances
tasks.detail: Copy canonical config -> TEST+server (CRLF-safe). AFTER: changelog **config updated** + bump version + generate zips to ship client+server.

tasks.label: Security: GitHub alerts across mods
tasks.detail: Pull GitHub Dependabot + code-scanning alerts across owned mods (is_mod). Fix at the ecosystem level (cargo/gradle bump). Needs gh authed. Run before a release.

tasks.label: Changelog: derive from git (per mod)
tasks.detail: Each owned mod's commits since its last release tag = its pending changelog (the commit IS the source, so it can never be stale/missing). --markdown for release-notes format. Curate wording at release.

tasks.label: Pack: changelog derive (bundles+config)
tasks.detail: Derive the WHOLE pack changelog for <baseline>..HEAD from git: mod add/update/remove (mod-director bundles + CF manifest, version-aware) PLUS game-config changes (src/common/config, mod-director/ excluded — one line per changed file, dirs with many files summarized, comment/blank-only edits filtered as noise). Baseline = commit of the last PUBLISHED pack version, not the last commit. Curate wording at release. Add --config-only / --no-config to scope.

tasks.label: Profile: spark (in-game, save-to-file)
tasks.detail: Drive /spark profiler via matoulib RPC (game must be up, -Dmatoulib.rpc=true). Saves .sparkprofile locally — NEVER uploads (spark.lucko.me = public).

tasks.label: Pack: RELEASE dry-run (gates+plan)
tasks.detail: Gated pack release DRY-RUN (read-only): tree clean + pack_sync consistency (Approved-only) + fork audit + bundle_check (fetchable/Approved) + changelog preview. Baseline = commit of the LAST PUBLISHED version.

tasks.label: Pack: RELEASE EXECUTE (uploads to CF!)
tasks.detail: Same gates, then FOR REAL: build zips + upload client+serverpack to CF (outward-publish) + prepend changelog. Push stays manual.

tasks.label: Pipeline: status (repo→release→CF→pack→instances)
tasks.detail: End-to-end delivery dashboard: unreleased commits per mod, CF latest file status, pack bundle refs, stale instance jars + NEXT ACTIONS. Read-only. Run at session start and before any release.

tasks.label: Wiki: sync OaT Mixins page (generate from code)
tasks.command: rm -rf /tmp/oat-wiki && git clone -q https://github.com/quentin452/OptimizationsAndTweaks.wiki.git /tmp/oat-wiki && python3 wiki_sync.py --wiki /tmp/oat-wiki && git -C /tmp/oat-wiki diff --stat
tasks.detail: Regenerate wiki Mixins.md from asm/Mixin.java + mixin javadocs (kills the stale-wiki class). Review the diff, then commit+push the wiki clone yourself (PUBLIC).
